description: This file contains locale/culture-specific configurations and functions for the Arabic (Egypt) date format, meant for use with the DateJS library. It defines the culture info (such as day and month names, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, and related methods) and extends the Date prototype with culture-aware date manipulation utilities.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of the date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day from its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month from its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Gets the timezone abbreviation from an offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Gets the timezone offset from a timezone name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components based on a configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves date to first day of the current month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves date to last day of the current month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves date to the nth occurrence of a weekday.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves date to a specific day of week.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the day within the month.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Gets the timezone abbreviation for the date.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone based on an offset.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date's timezone observes daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if DST is currently in effect for the date.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset in string format.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since the date.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts date to ISO string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the date based on the provided format specifier.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Parses a date string according to defined formats.

methods.name: parse

methods.name: parseExact
methods.description: Parses a date string with a specific format pattern.
